compiler_boundary.native_return: The six-argument foreign entry returns u64. Reject nonzero high32 wrapper status before interpreting low32 Core status; never truncate first. Core status is not a written extent or score.
compiler_boundary.seed_capacity_scope: The one-MiB capacity is established only for the compiler-None foreign-wrapper build branch. These finite frames fit that branch; this is not a global B3 native-capacity claim.
compiler_boundary.origin_note: An actual complete-source Git origin is assigned by the owning publication workflow. No commit identity is fabricated here.

consistency_addendum.name: fuzzy-wire-consistency-clarification-v1.json
consistency_addendum.rule: needle_previous_cased (word9) equals1 only if needle_original_scalars (word7) ispositive. Apply to every accepted state; reject forged zero-history context with INVALID before overflow, SHORT or any store.
consistency_addendum.compatibility: No field, offset, reservation, result or valid fresh Host transition changes. Frozen wire V2 itself remains unchanged.

literal_bank.proof_scope: Mechanical transcription of every original literal and bit field, with an exact inverse. No Unicode lookup table was expanded by executing a reference classifier or model.

wire_layout.scalar_encoding: Every numeric field is one unsigned little-endian 64-bit word. An i32 word is its low32 bit pattern zero-extended to u64. Do not sign-extend it on the wire. All Unicode scalar words must be <=0x10ffff and outside 0xd800..0xdfff; zero is valid.

header.name: flags
header.meaning: Zero except the exact END bit on normalization frames.

header.name: payload_bytes
header.meaning: Exact count of bytes following the 256-byte state; no trailing bytes are allowed.

header.name: argument_a
header.meaning: Begin: complete haystack byte length. Match: hay-record count. Normalization: zero.

header.name: argument_b
header.meaning: Begin: complete needle byte length. Match: needle-scalar count. Normalization: zero.

input.state: The exact 32-word state table begins at source offset64.

payload.Begin: Empty; source length exactly320. All state words are zero.
payload.LowerHaystack: The original next whole-scalar UTF-8 substring, N=payload_bytes, immediately at offset320.
payload.LowerNeedle: The original next whole-scalar UTF-8 substring, N=payload_bytes, immediately at offset320.
payload.Match: argument_a H hay records at offset320, each24 bytes; argument_b K needle scalar words immediately at offset320+24H. payload_bytes=24H+8K. There is no padding.

input.complete_size: source_len must equal320+payload_bytes, checked without overflowing u64/host usize. No unknown flags, extra words or source tails are accepted.

fields.name: phase
fields.meaning: Phase enum; zero only for the fresh Begin input.

fields.name: hay_bytes_total
fields.meaning: Original complete haystack byte length supplied at Begin.

fields.name: needle_bytes_total
fields.meaning: Original complete needle byte length supplied at Begin.

fields.name: hay_bytes_seen
fields.meaning: Number of original haystack bytes normalized.

fields.name: needle_bytes_seen
fields.meaning: Number of original needle bytes normalized.

fields.name: hay_original_scalars
fields.meaning: Number of original haystack Unicode scalars normalized.

fields.name: hay_lower_scalars
fields.meaning: Number of emitted normalized haystack scalar records.

fields.name: needle_original_scalars
fields.meaning: Number of original needle Unicode scalars normalized.

fields.name: needle_lower_scalars
fields.meaning: Number of emitted normalized needle scalar slots; replacements do not change it.

fields.name: needle_previous_cased
fields.meaning: Boolean Cased property of the nearest previous original non-Case_Ignorable scalar, or zero.

fields.name: sigma_pending
fields.meaning: Boolean: a preceding-cased-qualified Sigma slot is waiting for right context.

fields.name: sigma_slot
fields.meaning: Index in the normalized needle vector of the unresolved provisional normal sigma; zero when not pending.

fields.name: hay_cursor
fields.meaning: Next normalized haystack record to inspect while matching.

fields.name: needle_cursor
fields.meaning: Next normalized needle scalar to match.

fields.name: last_matched_original_lower_start
fields.meaning: First lowered slot of the original scalar containing the last actual matched lower slot; zero before any match.

fields.name: first_original_index
fields.meaning: Original scalar index of the first match; zero if has_match is zero.

fields.name: first_original_lower_start
fields.meaning: First normalized haystack slot of that first matched original scalar, not the first actual matched slot.

fields.name: last_lower_hit
fields.meaning: Position of the last actual normalized haystack match.

fields.name: last_matched_original_index
fields.meaning: Original scalar index of the last match; also the last unique index when any exists.

fields.name: unique_matches
fields.meaning: Count of unique original indices selected so far, including internal prefixes later discarded on None.

fields.name: outcome
fields.meaning: Outcome enum; Continue during all nonterminal phases.

fields.name: score_bits
fields.meaning: Zero-extended low32 representation of the final i32 score; zero except terminal Some.

fields.name: first_overflow_op
fields.meaning: Arithmetic-stage enum for the first original i32 overflow; zero if absent.

fields.name: overflow_lhs_bits
fields.meaning: Zero-extended low32 original operand for first_overflow_op; zero if absent.

fields.name: overflow_rhs_bits
fields.meaning: Zero-extended low32 original operand for first_overflow_op; zero if absent.

fields.name: r1_bits
fields.meaning: Zero-extended low32 wrapped result of last_i32 - first_i32; zero before terminal nonempty Some.

fields.name: r2_bits
fields.meaning: Zero-extended low32 wrapped result of r1 + 1; zero before terminal nonempty Some.

fields.name: r3_bits
fields.meaning: Zero-extended low32 wrapped result of r2 - needle_len_i32; zero before terminal nonempty Some.

fields.name: last_scanned_original_index
fields.meaning: Original index of the last consumed haystack record, including nonmatches.

fields.name: last_scanned_original_lower_start
fields.meaning: Original-character lower start carried by that last consumed haystack record.

fields.name: first_lower_hit
fields.meaning: The first actual matched lower slot; distinct from first_original_lower_start when the match begins inside an expansion.

fields.name: overflow_mask
fields.meaning: Bits 0,1,2 record overflow at arithmetic stages 1,2,3 after wrapped evaluation; zero elsewhere.

state.input_absolute_offset_rule: Add64 to each relative state byte_offset.
state.output_absolute_offset_rule: Add128 to each relative state byte_offset.
state.private_history_boundary: Canonical shape and cross-binding are necessary checks, not authentication that a caller actually followed every prior frame. The public host creates fresh state and copies only validated HIA transitions.

derived_presence.note: There are no has_match or has_scanned_hay wire words in V2. Their old words14/30 are repurposed without changing the32-word/256-byte layout.
